newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 28.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday :
* Indonesia's three legal political parties started the campaign period peacefully on Sunday ahead of the May 29 general elections.
* The rupiah was quoted at 2,431.00/2,432.00 at 0200 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,435.50/36.50.
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 53.38 points to close at 6,738.87.
* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index eased 0.51 points, or 0.08 percent, to close at 652.48 points.
* Indonesian cigarette maker PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna following a report that its first quarter 1997 net sales jumped to 561.2 billion rupiah from 446.3 billion in the same 1996 period.
* Pulp and paper firm Indah Kiat following a report that its 1996 net fell to 264.59 billion rupiah against 468.54 billion rupiah in the previous year.
* Property firm Summarecon following a report that its 1996 net was up to 38.50 billion rupiah against 35.32 billion rupiah in 1995.
* Petrochemical producer PT Try Polyta following a report that its 1996 net fell to 26.00 billion rupiah against 58.52 billion rupiah in 1995.
* Cement firm Cibinong, oil firm Medco and glass manufacturer Asahimas following announcements of their 1996 results.
* Telkom after reports the firm would pay a dividend of 41.25 rupiah per share for 1996.
* Bank Bira after a sharp rise in the firm's first quarter net profit.
* Small-sized property firm Elang Realty on continued market talk of a possible rights issue.
